title: IBM Langflow OSS 1.0.0 through 1.12.4 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to obtain sensitive information due…
description: IBM Langflow OSS versions 1.0.0 through 1.12.4 contain a vulnerability that allows a remote authenticated attacker to obtain sensitive information. This occurs due to improper sanitization of secrets during flow and project exports. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 6.5, indicating a medium severity impact primarily affecting confidentiality without impacting integrity or availability.
